summary.headline: Cascade Residential Services secures $927K in annual savings across HVAC, supplies, uniforms, and training programs
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ strategic-sourcing engagement delivered $927,045 in verified annual savings for Cascade across seven actively sourced categories. $319,789 is already locked-in from a signed national Carrier HVAC program, while an additional $607,256 is in late-stage implementation through executed MOUs, draft agreements, and vendor selections covering Lennox, Rheem, HVACR & Plumbing Supplies, Uniforms, Johnstone ECM, and Interplay technician training. Key wins include national pricing and rebates with Carrier, a 43 % uniform cost reduction by moving to Unifirst, and standardized supplier terms that simplify operations and boost rebate capture.
